source: Real building footprints for the map sculpture, pinned by modeling/pin_city_footprints.mjs from map/buildings.json of the FareSight Map Redesign export: City of Boston (BPDA) Boston_Buildings and City of Cambridge BASEMAP_Buildings. These are the compact, tower-like footprints the export page ranks first, in its order (every tower-like one, then the next 140). Each is {h, zone, tier, r, parts}: h the recorded height in feet; zone how far inside the export page's city zone it stands (0.35 to 1); tier 0 tower-like, 1 squatter; r its outline as [x0, z0, x1, z1, ...] in sculpture units x 100000 (x east, z south; shared/src/projection.ts); parts the adjoining footprints that share its walls, each [h, r].
